title: CSV File
description: Appends each record as a line to a file on disk. Suited to feeding a downstream batch job or a reporting tool that reads a directory rather than an API. Each attached contract writes its own file with its own columns.

configFields.name: path
configFields.label: Output file
configFields.description: Where to write, as a path inside the adapter's container. Defaults to this deployment's configured output file, so two contracts that do not set it will share one file and interleave.

configFields.name: columns
configFields.label: Columns
configFields.description: The columns to write, in order, e.g. [{"header": "first_name", "field": "firstName"}]. A list rather than an object because the order is part of the meaning and object key order is not preserved in storage. record_id is always written first and created_at always last, from the envelope -- do not list them.
